# NEW 2026-11-18 round 6 B3, the Ottoman interregnum after Ankara. Generated by gen_interregnum.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Timur holds the Ottoman sultan: an adult of the Ottoman dynasty imprisoned outside the Ottoman state, and
# either vanilla's capture flag on the Timur situation is readable or the prisoner is held by Timur.
oe_ivr_sultan_captured = {
    dynasty:ottomans_dynasty ?= { any_character_in_dynasty = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned is_adult = yes NOT = { owner ?= c:TUR } } }
    OR = {
        situation:rise_of_timur ?= { has_variable = situation_event_rot_capturing_the_ottoman_sultan_fired }
        dynasty:ottomans_dynasty ?= { any_character_in_dynasty = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned owner ?= { tag = TIM } } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The interregnum can begin (see the file header of gen_interregnum.py).
oe_ivr_can_begin = {
    tag = BYZ
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_bet_round }
    country_exists = c:TUR
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active }
    OR = { c:TUR = { is_neighbor_of = c:BYZ } location:edirne = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
    OR = {
        oe_ivr_sultan_captured = yes
        AND = { current_date >= 1395.1.1 c:TUR = { in_civil_war = yes } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .6: there is a third prince to switch to (neither the besieger nor the one we back).
oe_ivr_can_switch = { OR = { AND = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 1 oe_bet_leader_2 = yes oe_bet_alive_3 = yes } AND = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 1 oe_bet_leader_3 = yes oe_bet_alive_2 = yes } AND = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 2 oe_bet_leader_1 = yes oe_bet_alive_3 = yes } AND = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 2 oe_bet_leader_3 = yes oe_bet_alive_1 = yes } AND = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 3 oe_bet_leader_1 = yes oe_bet_alive_2 = yes } AND = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 3 oe_bet_leader_2 = yes oe_bet_alive_1 = yes } } }
